items.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
items.description: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

items.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
items.description: The buzz about the presidential election is already under way - here's what we learned this week.

items.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
items.description: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

items.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
items.description: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

items.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
items.description: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

items.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
items.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

items.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
items.description: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.

items.title: Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats
items.description: Scores of flights across Europe have received bomb threats this week, but no explosives have been found so far.

items.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
items.description: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

items.title: Dozens of Democrats eyeing 2028 presidential run, says former Obama aide
items.description: Jim Messina tells the BBC that after Democrats' midterm victories he's talked to "over two dozen campaigns", with some already hiring staff.

items.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
items.description: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.

items.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
items.description: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

items.title: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis
items.description: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.

items.title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
items.description: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.

items.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
items.description: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

items.title: Nigerian court rules opposition candidate cannot stand in elections
items.description: The high court has sacked the leadership of the opposition ADC party with only months to go until elections.

items.title: Macau jails pro-democracy campaigner in city's first national security case
items.description: Au Kam San was sentenced to 12 years and six months' jail for "subversion against the political power of the state".

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

items.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
items.description: The car company's CEO Elon Musk has said production will halt in Texas, to focus on the firm's self-driving Cybercabs.

items.title: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
items.description: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.
